description: Licence status of a capital markets counterparty. Returns the regulator's record of one firm: whether it is licensed, authorised or registered, by which regulator, for what, and since when the register says so. Give a Legal Entity Identifier, or a market and the regulator's firm number. Every field carries its source page and the date it was read. The record is signed; the read leaves a receipt.

firm_number.description: The regulator's firm number, exactly as the register writes it.

market.description: The market, two letters (for example uk). On a market's own MCP it may be left out.

version.description: A version of the record (default: the current version).

name: get_counterparty
title: Licence status of a counterparty
